sections.A: Andar ke organs aur thoracic spine ki nerves aapas mein judi hain, is liye organ ka dard peeth ya seene mein mehsoos ho sakta hai. Isay visceral referred pain kehte hain.
sections.B: Dard jo movement, posture ya aaraam se na badle, raat ko lagataar ho, bukhar, paseena ya wazan kam hone ke saath ho, ya khane ya saans se juda ho: yeh mechanical nahi lagta.
sections.C: Fracture, cancer ka phailna, infection, dil aur aorta ki bimariyan aur pet ke organ: har ek ke risk factors table mein hain.
sections.D: Vital signs, reedh ki haddi par thapki, taangon ka neuro exam aur qad napna pehli tarjeeh hain.
sections.G: Achanak cheerta hua dard, taangon ki kamzori ya peshab ki tabdeeli, cancer ki history ke saath naya dard, ya bukhar ke saath shadeed dard: foran refer karein.
sections.H: Agar movement se dard nahi badalta to andar ki ya serious wajah sochein. Vital signs ya neuro signs ke mutabiq sahi urgency se refer karein.
sections.I: Diagnosis ke baad physio ka kaam: osteoporotic fracture mein dard control, halki movement aur girne se bachao; cancer mein doctor ki hidayat ke mutabiq kaam.
sections.N: Sawaal hal karein. Yaad rakhein: aisa dard jo position se na badle zyada fikr wala hai.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
